thread.title: RockHounds hold contest for free tickets to playoff home game
thread.title_full: RockHounds hold contest for free tickets to playoff home game

author: Midland Times
title: RockHounds hold contest for free tickets to playoff home game
text:
The Midland RockHounds are offering fans a chance to win four free tickets to their home opener of the Division Series in the 2025 Texas League Playoffs. The team is set to host Game 2 of the Division Series at Momentum Bank Ballpark on September 18.
According to a July 30 Facebook post shared by the RockHounds, a link for the contest is provided. The contest is ongoing with a deadline of September 14 at 11:59 p.m.
Fans are instructed to share on their social media platforms for ten extra entries after registering. The official rules must be read before joining the contest.
Midland secured a playoff berth by finishing first in the Texas League South Division during the first half of the season. The team has been selling tickets for the postseason since earlier this month.
Tickets are available for Games 2 and 3 of both the Division Series and Championship Series scheduled for September, according to an earlier Facebook post from the RockHounds.
The team has assured that tickets for any playoff games not played will be refunded to the original payment method.
Season ticket holders have the option to receive a credit towards their account for next season if they choose not to use their tickets.
Currently, the RockHounds are hosting the Tulsa Drillers and defeated them with a score of 9-4 last night.
